L’Artisan

D’ATAR

The Fire. The Craftsmanship.

Atar

Persian

Atar is the Persian word for fire. In ancient Persia it was a symbol of purity and truth.

Fire turns the raw into the lasting. That is exactly what craftsmanship is: a piece is shaped until it outlasts time and use. L’Artisan d’Atar is the craftsman of fire.

That is why every piece is made only when you order it: for you alone, to your wishes, without haste and without a loud logo.
